claims.value: Lantern Slide (black and white); view of Rano Raraku quarry from a distance; moai statue road in the foreground, with teo groups of fallen moai (figure carvings) each; Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a lantern slide attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, photographed in 1914–1915. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact, and no image is published. The claim preserves the museum's complete Description wording, including its apparent typo ‘teo groups’. The longer curator's overview is not extracted.
